stepBody: Angela proposes to model some particular observation $$y_i$$ as follows: $$\hat{y}_i=\frac{1}{\theta_1}x_i$$\n\n(a)(ii) What is the value of $$\hat{\theta}_1$$ that minimizes MSE? The critical point you find is guaranteed to be a minimum, so you do not need to prove that this point is a minimum. Please simplify your answer in terms of $$x_i$$ $$y_i$$ and $$n.$$##figure1.gif##
